<thought>Based on the observed mass (M+H ≈ 121 Da → neutral mass ≈ 120 Da), the ¹H NMR showing only aromatic protons (5 H total), and the ¹³C NMR displaying a carbonyl carbon around 168 ppm plus aromatic carbons, the most consistent structure is a monosubstituted benzene bearing a carbonyl‑methyl group, i.e., acetophenone. Its molecular formula C₈H₈O matches the mass, and its SMILES is “CC(=O)c1ccccc1”.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)c1ccccc1</final_answer>
